outcome: International Consultation on Incontinence Questionnaire Female Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms Modules (ICIQ-FLUTS) scores
ICIQ Female Sexual Matters Associated with Lower Urinary Tract Symptoms Module (ICIQ-FLUTSsex) scores
cohort: The cohort consisted of 50 women who underwent urogenital fistula repair at a tertiary referral center between 2010 and 2023.
finding: Urogenital fistula repair at a specialized center demonstrates excellent closure rates and high patient satisfaction, though patients with urethrovaginal fistulas face an increased risk of stress urinary incontinence.
